    Plot MCMC Trace Plots

    urc_trace.Rd

    Creates trace plots for posterior samples from a JAGS MCMC model. Trace plots are displayed separately for each parameter, with MCMC chains distinguished by color.

    urc_trace(
  model,
  parameters = NULL,
  exclude = NULL,
  deviance = FALSE,
  chains = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  palette = NULL,
  alpha = 0.6,
  x_label = "Iteration",
  y_label = "Value",
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  scales = "free",
  ncol = NULL,
  nrow = NULL,
  line_args = list(),
  theme = ggplot2::theme_minimal(),
  theme_args = list(),
  ...
)

    Arguments

    model

    A fitted JAGS model object containing posterior samples.

    parameters

    Optional character vector specifying the parameters to plot. If NULL, all available parameters are plotted except loglik and, by default, deviance. Parameters can be specified by their exact name (e.g., "lambda[1]") or by their base name (e.g., "lambda"), which selects all indexed parameters.

    exclude

    Optional character vector specifying parameters to exclude from the plot. Exact parameter names or base parameter names can be used.

    deviance

    Logical; should posterior deviance be included? Defaults to FALSE.

    chains

    Optional numeric vector specifying the chains to plot. If NULL, all available chains are plotted.

    labels

    Optional named character vector used to rename parameter labels in the facets. Names can correspond to exact parameter names or base parameter names.

    palette

    Character vector of colors used for the MCMC chains. If NULL, a publication-friendly colorblind-safe palette is used. Colors are recycled if fewer colors are supplied than chains.

    alpha

    Numeric value between 0 and 1 controlling the transparency of the trace lines. Defaults to 0.6.

    x_label

    Character string specifying the x-axis label. Defaults to "Iteration".

    y_label

    Character string specifying the y-axis label. Defaults to "Value".

    title

    Optional plot title.

    subtitle

    Optional plot subtitle.

    caption

    Optional plot caption.

    scales

    Character string specifying the scales used for the facets. Must be one of "fixed", "free", "free_x", or "free_y". Defaults to "free".

    ncol

    Number of columns in the facet layout.

    nrow

    Number of rows in the facet layout.

    line_args

    Named list of additional arguments passed to ggplot2::geom_line(). These arguments override the corresponding defaults, including alpha.

    theme

    A ggplot2 theme object. Defaults to ggplot2::theme_minimal().

    theme_args

    Named list of arguments passed to ggplot2::theme().

    ...

    Additional ggplot2 layers or components added to the plot.

    Value

    A ggplot object showing MCMC trace plots.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
output <- urc_mcmc(x = mydata)

# Plot all parameters
urc_trace(output$models$poisson)

# Plot selected parameters
urc_trace(
  output$models$zip,
  parameters = c("lambda", "pi")
)

# Plot a specific indexed parameter
urc_trace(
  output$models$zip,
  parameters = "lambda[1]"
)

# Plot all lambda parameters
urc_trace(
  output$models$zip,
  parameters = "lambda"
)

# Exclude a parameter
urc_trace(
  output$models$zip,
  exclude = "pi"
)

# Plot only selected chains
urc_trace(
  output$models$poisson,
  chains = c(1, 2)
)

# Rename parameters
urc_trace(
  output$models$zip,
  labels = c(
    lambda = "Mean Count",
    pi = "Zero-Inflation Probability"
  )
)

# Change transparency
urc_trace(
  output$models$poisson,
  alpha = 0.3
)

# Customize chain colors
urc_trace(
  output$models$poisson,
  palette = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00")
)

# Use grayscale
urc_trace(
  output$models$poisson,
  palette = c("black", "grey50")
)

# Customize line appearance
urc_trace(
  output$models$poisson,
  line_args = list(
    linewidth = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.3
  )
)

# Publication-style theme
urc_trace(
  output$models$poisson,
  theme = ggplot2::theme_classic()
)

# Add additional ggplot layers
urc_trace(output$models$poisson) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  )
} # }
